source_note: Primary sources are official Orange County Notices of Commencement and other public records. News articles are secondary references only.

permits.title: Haunted Mansion – General Construction (MLC Theming)
permits.description: Disney’s Facility Asset Management team filed a Notice of Commencement for “General Construction” at 1600 Magic Kingdom Dr, the address of The Haunted Mansion. Contractor: MLC Theming (specialty firm for scenic painting, aging, facades, and rock work). Similar to a February 2025 filing at the same location. Standard one-year expiration (August 28, 2027). Filed by FAM (typically maintenance-oriented) rather than Imagineering, following the recently completed exterior refurbishment; scope could relate to finishing work or other interior/exterior activity.
permits.location: Magic Kingdom – The Haunted Mansion (1600 Magic Kingdom Dr)

permits.title: Spaceship Earth – Install Signage (Jon Richards Company)
permits.description: Walt Disney Imagineering filed a Notice of Commencement to “install signage” at 2060 Avenue of the Stars, the approximate address for Spaceship Earth at EPCOT. Contractor: Jon Richards Company (frequent themed-elements collaborator with prior work at Test Track 3.0, Walt Disney Studios sign, and Monstropolis). Standard one-year expiration. Filed by Imagineering (rather than Facility Asset Management), suggesting visible/thematic work. Comes ahead of the major Spaceship Earth reimagining announced at D23 Expo 2026 focused on human connection; no closure or timeline announced yet.
permits.location: EPCOT – Spaceship Earth (2060 Avenue of the Stars)

permits.title: Antonio’s Fiesta de Encanto – General Construction (InterAmerica Stage)
permits.description: Walt Disney Imagineering filed a Notice of Commencement for “General Construction” at 504 Dinoland Dr, the address of the upcoming Antonio’s Fiesta de Encanto ride in the Tropical Americas land at Disney’s Animal Kingdom. Contractor: InterAmerica Stage (specializes in stage rigging and machinery; possible work on ride sets/scenic elements). Standard one-year expiration. Attraction (revealed at D23) focuses on the day Antonio received his gift of talking to animals, expands the film plot with new scenes, travels on multiple levels, and has no height requirement. Part of Tropical Americas (opening 2027).
permits.location: Disney’s Animal Kingdom – Tropical Americas / Antonio’s Fiesta de Encanto (504 Dinoland Dr)

permits.title: Rock 'n' Roller Coaster Starring The Muppets – Labor/Materials/Electrical (Buena Vista Construction)
permits.description: Disney’s Sourcing & Procurement department filed a Notice of Commencement for Rock ‘n’ Roller Coaster Starring The Muppets at Disney’s Hollywood Studios. Contractor: Buena Vista Construction Company (Disney’s in-house construction team) to “Provide labor, materials and/or electrical for construction”. Filed August 26, 2026; standard one-year expiration. Ride reopened May 2026 after Aerosmith-to-Muppets retheme. Scope appears maintenance-oriented (similar to recent Magic of Disney Animation filings) rather than further thematic changes.
permits.location: Disney’s Hollywood Studios – Rock 'n' Roller Coaster Starring The Muppets

permits.title: Former Star Wars: Galactic Starcruiser – General Construction Extension (Balfour Beatty)
permits.description: Disney’s Facility Asset Management team filed a Notice of Commencement for “General Construction” at the former Star Wars: Galactic Starcruiser building (201 S Studio Dr), which is being converted into Walt Disney Imagineering offices. Contractor: Balfour Beatty Construction LLC. The filing is identical to the permit recorded on August 26, 2025 and serves as an extension of the now-expired prior NOC; new expiration is August 25, 2027. Scope is general/maintenance-oriented (Facility Asset Management rather than Imagineering). Theming removal and conversion to office space continue.
permits.location: Former Star Wars: Galactic Starcruiser (201 S Studio Dr) – being converted to WDI offices

permits.title: North Service Area (NSA) Marina Dock Expansion – SFWMD Environmental Resource Permit
permits.description: Walt Disney Parks and Resorts, U.S., Inc. filed an SFWMD application for the NSA Dock Expansion at the North Service Area Marina on Bay Lake (backstage facility for storing and servicing Disney watercraft). Covers 0.89 acres east of Facilities Way. Scope: 20-ft floating dock extension with relocated pile; new floating dock addition with 40-ft fingers; total dock area from ~3,400 to ~4,800 sq ft; nine existing pilings replaced, four relocated, eight new; dredging ~718 cubic yards to 86.5 ft (Disney datum). No water quality or attenuation impacts expected. Compensating storage from existing surplus. Vessel capacity noted for six 66-ft cruisers and six 38-ft launches. No public construction timeline announced.
permits.location: Bay Lake – North Service Area Marina (backstage)

permits.title: Carousel of Progress – Electrical Work (Solotech)
permits.description: Walt Disney Imagineering filed a Notice of Commencement for electrical work at Walt Disney’s Carousel of Progress in Magic Kingdom. Contractor: Solotech (audiovisual technologies including speakers and lighting). Standard one-year expiration. Attraction is closed for major reimagining (timeline shift to late 20th/early 21st century) and scheduled to reopen in 2027. Prior permits covered scenic sets and steel.
permits.location: Magic Kingdom – Carousel of Progress (1205 Monorail Way)

permits.title: Former PizzeRizzo (Monstropolis) – Electrical Work (Solotech)
permits.description: Walt Disney Imagineering filed a Notice of Commencement for electrical work at the former PizzeRizzo building in Disney’s Hollywood Studios. Contractor: Solotech (audiovisual). Standard one-year expiration. Building is being re-themed as part of Muppets Courtyard conversion to Monstropolis (Monsters, Inc.–themed quick-service restaurant). No opening timeframe announced.
permits.location: Disney’s Hollywood Studios – Former PizzeRizzo / Monstropolis

permits.title: Signage Installation – Polynesian Village, Riviera Resort, Wilderness Lodge (Kentavo)
permits.description: Walt Disney Imagineering filed three Notices of Commencement for ‘Install signage’ at Disney’s Polynesian Village Resort, Disney’s Riviera Resort, and Disney’s Wilderness Lodge. Contractor: Kentavo. Polynesian signage may relate to new Floridian Way traffic pattern or recently opened bus stop. Wilderness Lodge work aligns with ongoing exterior refurbishment and security kiosk expansion. Riviera purpose unclear (possible replacement of existing signage).
permits.location: Multiple resorts – Polynesian Village Resort, Riviera Resort, Wilderness Lodge
